Render validation reports

Source: R/reports.R
render_reports.Rd

Render validation reports

Usage

render_reports(
  variables,
  concordance,
  ev,
  out_dir = "reports",
  template = report_template(),
  index = TRUE
)

Arguments

variables

Character vector of variable names.

concordance

Concordance in the v1 layout.

ev

Evidence list from load_evidence().

out_dir

Output directory for HTML files.

template

Parent template (default: the package's inst/reports/variable-report.Rmd).

index

Also write index.html listing the rendered reports.

Value

Invisibly, a data.frame with one row per report.
